meta.reset: Reset DB, cache and search index to `fixtures` before every case. Actor rows are seeded by the harness (permissions = session mask) and are not listed in fixtures. Inject sessions directly. Languages and categories from `fixtures` are inserted with the shared flags on the category and one name per translation.
meta.actor: Key into fixtures.actors, or: anonymous (no Authorization header), garbage_session, expired_session. Actor mask is derived from actor.caps (resource -> action names; actions: create, update, delete). Reading and searching need only a valid session.
meta.request: path_params are unescaped and must be percent-encoded when substituted. headers: a value of null removes a default header (default: Authorization from actor; Content-Type application/json whenever a body is sent). body_raw (even empty string) overrides body. body_generator {json_padded_bytes: N, base} = valid JSON of exactly N bytes, padded with an unknown field.
meta.tokens: {$repeat: {s, n}} string s repeated n times. Tokens appear only as direct field values (body, headers, path_params, assertion value).
meta.expect.body: empty | plain_text | json | any. Defaults used by the author: 201/204 -> empty, 4xx -> plain_text, 200 -> json.
meta.json_assertions: ops: eq, ne, type, len_eq, len_lte, gte, includes, excludes, is_null, not_null, unix_or_null, sorted_asc, sorted_desc. Paths with [*] resolve to lists. type values: array, integer, boolean, string.
meta.eventually_ms: Retry the step until it passes or the timeout elapses (indexing is async).
meta.source: documented = rules inside the source_document; stated = rules you gave outside the source_document; inferred = derived from code or conventions.
meta.tags: boundary, cache, security, regression, assumes_distinct_bits (create/update/delete are separate bits).
